senses.gloss:
Sleep,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓsvap 2 P, SI 2 A, saMviS 6 P, ni-drA 2 P, nidrAyate (D.); ‘I also do not s(leep) over this matter’ mayApyasmin vastuni na SayAnena sTIyate (Mu. 1).
Ⓔs.ⒹnidrA, svapnaH, svApaH, supti f., SayanaM, saMveSaH; ‘go to s(leep)’ nidrAM yA 2 P; See (v.); ‘fall into s(leep)’ nidrayA aBiBU pass. or Akram pass.; ‘he fell into a deep s(leep)’ gAQa-nidrABiBUtaH-viDeyaH-baBUva; ‘death-s(leep)’ Gora-kAla-nidrA; ‘roused from s(leep)’ vinidra, Bagnanidra, praboDita.
Ⓝ[Sleep]er,Ⓒs.ⒹnidrAluH, SayAluH, better by (v.).
Ⓝ[Sleep]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹSayanaM, nidrA, &c.; ‘s(leeping)-house’ SayanamaMdiraM-gfhaM.
Ⓔa.ⒹnidrARa, Sayita, SayAna, supta; ‘s(leeping) draught’ nidrAkaramOzaDaM.
Ⓝ[Sleep]less,Ⓒa.Ⓓnazwanidra, unnidra, a-vi-nidra, nirRidra; ‘passes s(leepless) nights’ unnidrAH-utsannanidrAH-kzapA gamayati.
Ⓝ[Sleep]lessness,Ⓒs.ⒹnidrAnASaH, nirRidratA, nidrABAvaH.
Ⓝ[Sleep]y,Ⓒa.ⒹnidrAlu, SayAlu, taMdrAlu, nidrASIla.
Ⓑ
 2 nidrAkrAMta, nidrApara-vaSa-viDeya-aBiBUta-Akula-grasta.
Ⓑ
 3 nidrAprada-janana (nI f.), svApakara (rI f.).
Ⓑ
 4 suzupsu, SiSayizu, SayanecCu; ‘to feel s(leepy)’ svap-SI- desid.; ‘I feel s(leepy)’ nidrayA'pahriye-parABUye, suzupsAmi.
Sleet,Ⓒs.ⒹSIkaraH, tuzAraH or SIkara-varzaH or AsAraH.
Sleeve,Ⓒs.ⒹpippalaH; ‘to laugh in oneʼs s(leeve)’ aMtar has 1 P.

Slender,Ⓒa.Ⓓpra-, tanu, kfSa, kzIRa, kzAma; ‘having a s(lender) waist’, ‘s(lender)-waisted’ kzIRa or tanu-maDya or maDyama, kfSodara, mfga or siMha-kawi or maDya; ‘s(lender)-waisted woman’ suma-DyamA, kfSodarI, tanumaDyA, vedivilagnamaDyA.
Ⓑ
 2 alpa, kzudra, laGu, tanu; ‘possessed of s(lender) means’ kzIRaviBava.
Ⓝ[Slender]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹtanutA, kfSatA, kArSyaM, tAnavaM, alpatA.
